download_dataset: download and unpack the UCO3D dataset to a local folder with parallel workers and optional checksum verification
download_file: download a single dataset file with progress bar, SHA256 checksum check, and retry support
unpack_file: extract a downloaded zip archive to the target folder with optional archive cleanup
sha256_file: compute the SHA256 hash digest of a file using a 64KB block size buffer
download_with_progress_bar: download a file from a URL or copy from a local path with tqdm progress bar display
